title: fastpath: add gating + precision toggle with safe-mode fallback for KV cache and continuous batching
author: Priya Menon
description: Context: The fastpath codepath provides significant latency wins for short context LLM inference but has historically been brittle for edge cases (KV cache corruption, numeric instability with low-precision kernels, and continuous-batcher boundary conditions). Motivation: Ship a safer fastpath that keeps perf benefits while eliminating correctness regressions observed in recent canaries. This PR introduces three coordinated mechanisms: 1) a gating layer that evaluates per-request heuristics (sequence length distribution, KV cache warm/cold markers, and kernel compatibility flags) and routes to the fastpath only when safe; 2) a runtime precision toggle that allows selected layers to run in lower precision for throughput while keeping fallbacks to higher precision when outputs deviate beyond a threshold; 3) a safe-mode fallback that performs lightweight runtime checks (KV checksum on hot cache entries, attention kernel sanity checks) and automatically routes requests to the slow but correct path when anomalies are detected. Implementation summary: - runtime/fastpath/gating.rs: new gating API that exposes pluggable heuristics and a small state machine to track request-level eligibility across retries. - runtime/fastpath/precision.rs: precision toggle and score-based divergence detector; integrates with kernel selection to pick BF16/FP16/FP32 per-layer. - runtime/kv/cache.rs: added optional per-entry checksum and repair flow; exposes a lightweight async validator used by safe-mode. - runtime/batching/continuous_batcher.cpp: tightened boundary handling for warm-up batches to avoid KV shadowing when switching routes. - tests/fastpath/integration_test.py: expanded test coverage for race conditions, checksum corruptions, and precision-induced divergence. - docs/fastpath.md: design doc and rollout checklist. Rollout plan: default behavior keeps fastpath off for tenants flagged as conservative. For the hosted pool we will enable gating with conservative heuristics and monitor canaries for 48h. If stable, progressively enable precision toggle for compatible models and hardware. Observability: new metrics fastpath.gate.allowed, fastpath.gate.denied.reason, fastpath.precision.diverged_count, kv.safe_mode.triggered. Benchmarks: microbenchmarks show median p50 token latency improvement of ~18% on short sequences and p99 improvements of ~8% when fastpath is engaged; end-to-end throughput improves 12% on representative chat workload with no statistically significant regen rate increase in canary. Backout plan: feature flags per-cluster and per-tenant; abort and force all requests through slow path if divergence regressions exceed threshold. CI: unit/integration/benchmarks are included and required for merging.

review_comments: Ethan Liu: Can you expand on the heuristics used by the gate? What are the false-positive/negative tradeoffs?
Priya Menon: Gate uses conservative thresholds initially (seq_len<=128, cache_hit_ratio>=0.8, kernel_supported flag). We included telemetry to iterate thresholds before wider rollout.
María Gonzales: The divergence detector thresholds look tight; how did you pick them?
Priya Menon: Tuned on 10k workloads across three models with a held-out eval set. We log divergence traces for manual inspection and report them to the regression dashboard.
Kenji Saito: KV checksum repair path looks async; what's the latency impact?
Priya Menon: Repair is opportunistic and done off-path when possible; on-path repair downgrades to safe-mode which routes to slow path to preserve correctness.
ci_checks: benchmarks: perf +12% throughput on end-to-end chat canary, p50 -18% latency
merge_outcome: merged into main after green CI and approvals
release_notes: Adds fastpath gating and precision toggle with a safe-mode fallback to improve throughput and reduce fastpath-induced correctness incidents. Rollout guarded by feature flags. New metrics added for gate decisions and precision divergence.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover gating state machine and precision logic. Integration tests simulate KV corruption and validate safe-mode reroute. Canaries ran for 48h in eu-west-1 with no regressions. Benchmark harness attached shows target perf improvements.
observability_notes: Added metrics: fastpath.gate.allowed, fastpath.gate.denied.reason, fastpath.precision.diverged_count, kv.safe_mode.triggered. Traces include gate decision tag and kernel precision used.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: low-precision kernels can introduce subtle drift causing downstream hallucination/regressions. Mitigation: divergence detector with conservative thresholds, canary rollout, per-tenant opt-out, automatic fallback to slow path.
migration_instructions: No DB migrations. Operators can toggle feature flags per-cluster. Recommend enabling gating for small % of traffic initially and monitoring fastpath.precision.diverged_count.
notes: This PR touches hot codepaths; please coordinate with SRE before broad rollout. See docs/fastpath.md for config knobs and rollout checklist.
